description: Use this when an affiliate asks when they get paid: approved commission not yet paid (per currency and in USD), commission still pending review, the next payment as an estimate with its threshold, and the payment method as its type (a bank account shows only its last 4 digits). Read-only; never returns account numbers, PayPal addresses, postal or tax data. Requires your own Clickwise affiliate API key on the MCP connection (X-API-Key header or Authorization: Bearer); acts only on your account.
name: get_payment_status
title: Get my payment status
